## If blood cultures are positive, refer to the Bacteremia order menus in the
## inpatient

Antimicrobial CDSS (link below).
***ALERT*** Leaving ED Antimicrobial CDSS! When ordering antimicrobials from the
inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS, STAT priority must be manually selected.
Link to Bacteremia order menus in the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS
## Choice of antimicrobials
Select antimicrobials active against any suspected site of infection that may be
present. Return to main menu and refer to the source infection's page within
the Antimicrobial CDSS.
## For patients with an intravascular catheter, refer to the intravascular-
## associated infection page in the Systemic Infections section of the Inpatient
## Antimicrobial CDSS
## Empirical therapy for mild to moderate infection, focal infection not found
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT ($) [M]
## Empirical therapy for severe infection
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT ($) [M] < AND > vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once
STAT ($) [R]
## Empirical therapy for immunosuppressed patients
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT ($$) <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg
IV once STAT ($) [R]
## For patients with penicillin allergy
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV once STAT ($) [R] <AND> aztreonam 2 gm IV once STAT
($$$$) [R]
